title: Few physicists in the crash-retrieval program

tellings.quote:
Like your
last interview pointed out how few
physicists there were for the retrieval
program.

plain: Very few physicists worked in the secret programme said to recover crashed non-human craft, according to an earlier guest on the show. A NASA engineer named Charles Buhler brings this up with Michels, pointing back to that earlier interview; it would suggest the programme has had too few scientists to make sense of what it holds.
